annotations.title: Read the files of a website builder draft

description: Use this when someone wants their website builder draft changed, to see its files before editing them. Returns the list of files, or the complete contents of up to 10 files, at the newest checkpoint or one named. Not for the settings of the public site.

checkpoint.description: Read the files as an earlier checkpoint left them; leave out for the newest

paths.description: Files to read, such as src/copy.js; leave out to list every file

name: read_website_files

checkpoint.description: The checkpoint these files were read at; write_website_files takes it as parentCheckpoint

paths.description: Every file of the website, when no paths were asked for

skippedPaths.description: Files too large for this answer; read each in a call of its own

title: Read the files of a website builder draft
